summary: Testing completed for Terrain Editor and Path Debugger features. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all requested features work correctly: Terrain Editor paint mode with save controls, Path Debugger origin/destination selection, debug mode activation, and database save functionality.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up automatically during pytest run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Terrain Editor and Path Debugger endpoints are fully functional. Backend has endpoints at /api/data/terrain-zones, /api/data/land-type-zones, and /api/data/custom-paths. Frontend pages at /terrain-editor and /path-debugger work correctly. Location selection in Path Debugger requires clicking directly on the SVG circle elements.
